The original other 135 Gram comparisons, cost comparison and endpoint SOC comparison must remain passed; any additional or different failure is fatal.

The source-bound raw theta/alpha round trip is checked bitwise. The scale-1 gamma-minus counterpart has the same operation order in the unchanged model conventions. The H*h0 coordinate chain is not involved in the selected entry.

The preprocessing loss bound rho*abs(a)+E follows round-to-nearest binary64 multiplication/division with gradual underflow. E retains eta/2 in exact rational arithmetic; it never becomes a zero floating-point constant.

The complete normal coefficient K=[beta+C/(1-u)]/(1-beta), with beta=u+(1+u)*gamma(N)^2, is verified exactly to fit the inherited Gamma=gamma(8*N+128). The additive B covers Jacobian scaling loss, both product underflows, old summation/final-division effects and the final unscaling underflow.

The counterpart L1 norm bound uses the saved nonnegative compensated diagonal, includes possible squared-term underflow, applies Cauchy-Schwarz, and uses an outward decimal square root verified by an exact rational square. B remains outside 1/(1-beta), consistent with the independent derivation.

Downward rounding of the old floating-point allowance is recovered separately. The final comparison uses exact rational error and allowance; displayed float bounds are rounded upward. No voltage, truth, observed-error floor or covariance modification is introduced.
The qualification rejects an oversized subnormal discrepancy and additional failed entries; eligibility alone does not imply acceptance.

limits_of_review: This is a pre-execution source and arithmetic review, not a claim that the continuation has run or will satisfy its objective or resource gates.

The underflow bound is conditional on the bound common computed stream, round-to-nearest gradual-underflow arithmetic and finite nonoverflowing operations. It does not bound libm, physical-model or derivative-recurrence error against exact real physics.
The adaptation is explicitly informed by the observed original numerical bookkeeping failure; it is separately documented and does not erase or relabel that failed attempt.

The supported reference prior is the deliberately specified common prior, not a reconstruction of the actual recursive posterior. A feasible computed-cost improvement is not a MAP, global optimum, calibrated coverage or production interval repair.
The retained host-reference resource accounting does not establish the target embedded SRAM/compute implementation budget.
